menu.treadlightly.option.enabled.tooltip: Turn the mod off without uninstalling it. The game's own footsteps come back.
menu.treadlightly.option.exclusive.toolt: Silence the game's own footsteps for anything this mod covers, so the two are not heard on top of each other. Turning this off gives you both.
menu.treadlightly.option.foliage.tooltip: How loud plants brushing against your legs are. Only heard barefoot, or when sprinting.
menu.treadlightly.option.footwear.toolti: Add the sound of the boots being worn on top of the surface underfoot.
menu.treadlightly.option.hostile.tooltip: Volume of footsteps from mobs that attack you.
menu.treadlightly.option.max_entities.to: How many entities may have footsteps at once. Past this, players and the nearest of each kind are kept and the rest go quiet.
menu.treadlightly.option.multiplayer.too: Whether footsteps play on multiplayer servers as well as in single player.
menu.treadlightly.option.passive.tooltip: Volume of footsteps from everything else.
menu.treadlightly.option.running.tooltip: Extra volume added as an entity works up to a run, so sprinting is louder than walking. Zero keeps them the same.
menu.treadlightly.option.stance.tooltip: How your own footsteps are paced. Automatic picks two legs.
menu.treadlightly.option.targets.tooltip: Which entities get footsteps. Narrowing this is the cheapest way to reduce the mod's cost in a crowd.
menu.treadlightly.option.volume.tooltip: How loud footsteps are overall. At zero the mod stops working entirely rather than playing silence.
menu.treadlightly.option.wet.tooltip: How loud the splash layered over a step is when the ground is wet, waterlogged, or out in the rain.
menu.treadlightly.title: Tread Lightly
mod.treadlightly.name: Tread Lightly
